test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Pay the electricity bill for the month of April.

options.text: The electricity bill for the month of April has to be paid.
We should pay the electricity bill for the month of April.
Let us pay the electricity bill for the month of April.
Let the electricity bill for the month of April be paid.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Let the electricity bill for the month of April be paid.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• The rules for changing an imperative sentence from active to passive voice is as follows:

 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• An imperative sentence in the passive voice has the following form:
 
• Structure:
 
 
• The root form of an instruction verb + Subject to take a specific action. (Active voice)
 
• Let + object + be + past participle of the instruction verb. (Passive voice)
 
• Example: ​
 
 
• *Carry it home. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Let it be carried home. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *Let the electricity bill for the month of April be paid.*
